note: GAM-012 The Number — one bounded statistic a day. STARTER SET = engine-demo neutral verifiable figures with sensible range bounds (so it's answerable, not a blind guess). The DATA-NATIVE questions (drawn from Claridas article findings, each with the true value + source + retrieval date + articleUrl, factual series only) are EDITORIAL/DATA (Onett) — same plumbing as GAM-011. These starters make the engine playable day one. Each item: prompt, answer (number), unit, min, max, optional step, context, source, retrieved, optional articleUrl.

items.prompt: How many member states belong to the United Nations?
items.context: South Sudan, admitted in 2011, was the most recent to join.

items.prompt: How many elements are on the periodic table?
items.context: The four newest were formally named in 2016.

items.prompt: How many bones are in the adult human body?
items.context: Infants are born with about 270; some fuse with age.

items.prompt: How many countries share a land border with Brazil?
items.context: Every South American country except Ecuador and Chile.

items.prompt: How many time zones does Russia officially span?
items.context: From Kaliningrad in the west to Kamchatka in the east.

items.prompt: How many keys are on a standard full-size piano?
items.context: 52 white and 36 black, spanning just over seven octaves.

items.prompt: Claridas ranked every qualifying skill-position player by 2025 PPR points. How many players cleared the thresholds?
items.context: Across four positions — quarterback, running back, wide receiver and tight end.

items.prompt: As the Fed cut its benchmark 170 basis points in 2024-2026, the 10-year Treasury yield moved the opposite way. By how many basis points did it rise?
items.context: Thirty-year mortgages price off the 10-year, so the Fed's cuts gave homebuyers no direct relief.

items.prompt: How many basis points did the Federal Reserve raise its benchmark rate between November 2021 and August 2023?
items.context: From 0.08 percent to 5.33 percent — one of the fastest tightening cycles on record.

items.prompt: In 2025, what share of the retail beef dollar went to the farmer, per USDA's Meat Price Spreads series?
items.context: Up from 37.3 percent in 2020 — the farmer's share rose even as beef packing stayed concentrated.

items.prompt: Of the 217 economies in the 2023 World Bank fertility series, how many reported fertility below the 2.1 replacement rate?
items.context: A majority — up from 98 in 2013 and 80 in 2000.

items.prompt: On a 2025 city-council docket, what share of the instruments the council adopts were resolutions rather than bills?
items.context: 1,346 resolutions to 308 bills — a 4.4-to-1 ratio; much of a council's work is not lawmaking.
items.source: Claridas — what a city council does

items.prompt: Claridas ran a Pythagorean expected-wins formula on all 30 MLB clubs through Sept 7, 2026. How many finished exactly at their projected win total?
items.context: 12 clubs outperformed the formula and 14 fell short.
